backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report describing 13 specific XPath‑targeted opacity updates in ServicesSection.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend components and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS base styles defining color tokens, themes, and shared utilities.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading fonts, metadata, and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Assembles the marketing site sections with nav and footer.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Contac: Contact form with validation plus email, phone, and coverage info cards.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Covera: Section describing nationwide coverage, venue expertise, and experience with a map image.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Footer: Footer with company info, quick links, contact details, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/marketing/HeroSe: Hero area with background image, company messaging, and CTA buttons that scroll to contact.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Servic: Renders a services grid with cards showing icons, descriptions, and background images. Includes hover effects and a styled section header.
frontend/src/components/marketing/TopNav: Implements a responsive top navigation bar with scroll-based styling and smooth section scrolling. Supports a mobile dropdown menu.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity using react-query. Recreates and invalidates queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and identity restoration logic. Wraps children in a provider using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend queries are needed.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus custom color variables, typography, and utility classes including text shadows for services.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React, QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and global CSS.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and utilities using OKLCH variables and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current marketing website state, including features, issues, and styling notes. Highlights readability problems in the Services section and marks the update as a fix request.
